OWN = ownership of dwellings. Productive capital stock is not in this table (see abs_mfp).

factor_income.description: Factor income by ANZSIC division, FY2010-11 to FY2024-25 (ASNA Tables 46 and 48): compensation of employees (wages and salaries plus employers' social contributions), gross operating surplus and gross mixed income, total factor income. labour_share = coe / tfi (derived here; mixed income of unincorporated businesses is counted with capital). OWN = ownership of dwellings; TOT = all industries.

gva.description: Gross value added at basic prices by ANZSIC division, FY2010-11 to FY2024-25 (ASNA Table 5). OWN = ownership of dwellings; TOT = all industries (GVA at basic prices). Shares are as published (the workbook labels the unit 'proportion' but the values are per cent). Chain volume series are not additive.
